# openinfra_nat_gateway (Resource)

The border device for a private kind: Vpc (kube-ovn VpcNatGateway) — the AWS NAT Gateway (SNAT egress) and, on a flat /24, the Internet-Gateway role. Requires the kube-ovn CNI.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `internal_ip` (String) The gateway's IP on `subnet` (lanIp). Set the VPC's default route (kind: Vpc routes) to this.
- `name` (String) Resource name. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `subnet` (String) A kind: Subnet in the VPC hosting the gateway's internal leg.
- `vpc` (String) The parent kind: Vpc.

### Optional

- `egress` (Attributes) SNAT egress — the AWS NAT-Gateway function. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--egress))
- `external_network` (String) The external (macvlan) network for public IPs.
- `namespace` (String) Kubernetes namespace. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `node_selector` (Map of String) Node placement for the gateway pod (a stable edge node, not a chaos-tested one).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `namespace/name`, the import identifier.
- `ready` (Boolean) Whether the resource's Ready condition is True. Terraform returns as soon as the object is accepted, so this is usually `false` immediately after apply — the platform reconciles asynchronously.

<a id="nestedatt--egress"></a>
### Nested Schema for `egress`

Optional:

- `public_ip` (String) The egress public IP. Omit to auto-allocate.
- `source_cidrs` (List of String) Private CIDRs whose outbound traffic is SNAT'd to public_ip.
